metadata.source_count_semantics: GEO reports CellRanger 2.2 count and per-run aggr, hg19. Aggr normalization mode not established.
metadata.source_cell_scope: All deposited native cell columns with exact originalGEOcapture prefixes; commonRNAQC. Author annotation subset retained as optional metadata, without claiming reproduction of author cell selection.
metadata.source_primary_cell_scope: Publication70781cells; deposited70780cell columns; author annotation69745rows. Differences recorded, not force-matched.
metadata.source_gene_policy: Native Ensembl primary IDs, secondary IDs and original symbols retained.10623source gene rows lack symbols; their Ensembl coordinates and counts remain in native libraries/geometry while absent symbols do not map to annotation reference genes. Repeated gene metadata columns are verified and excluded from expression counts. Different gene universes remain separate.
metadata.source_clinical_policy: Age/sex and detailed clinical covariates unjoined. Cancer/response/visit are original per-captureGEOfields verified against author annotations where present.
metadata.source_visit_policy: C1baseline/C3after chemotherapy/C5after combination treatment per primary Methods; C13/C15/EOT remain literal codes without invented exact timing.
metadata.source_geometry_policy: AuthorUMAP/major and subcluster labels are metadata only. No embeddings define native gene-expression centroid geometry.
metadata.source_split_policy: Unassigned; all visits of a donor must share a split. Source capture/run retained for batch auditing. Global aliases unresolved.

geo_samples.donor_id: Pooled source capture records; use exact source capture assignments

metadata.source_count_semantics: GEO reports CellRanger 2.2 count and per-run aggr, hg19. Aggr normalization mode not established.
metadata.source_cell_scope: All deposited native cell columns with exact originalGEOcapture prefixes; commonRNAQC. Author annotation subset retained as optional metadata, without claiming reproduction of author cell selection.
metadata.source_primary_cell_scope: Publication70781cells; deposited70780cell columns; author annotation69745rows. Differences recorded, not force-matched.
metadata.source_gene_policy: Native Ensembl primary IDs, secondary IDs and original symbols retained.10623source gene rows lack symbols; their Ensembl coordinates and counts remain in native libraries/geometry while absent symbols do not map to annotation reference genes. Repeated gene metadata columns are verified and excluded from expression counts. Different gene universes remain separate.
metadata.source_clinical_policy: Age/sex and detailed clinical covariates unjoined. Cancer/response/visit are original per-captureGEOfields verified against author annotations where present.
metadata.source_visit_policy: C1baseline/C3after chemotherapy/C5after combination treatment per primary Methods; C13/C15/EOT remain literal codes without invented exact timing.
metadata.source_geometry_policy: AuthorUMAP/major and subcluster labels are metadata only. No embeddings define native gene-expression centroid geometry.
metadata.source_split_policy: Unassigned; all visits of a donor must share a split. Source capture/run retained for batch auditing. Global aliases unresolved.
